system.description:
In a grim mercy, you lay your hand over a willing mortal's heart and release her from the trials of earthly existence, granting the peaceful death she longs for.

Touch your subject and spend a Willpower Trait; no challenge is made. The mortal must truly want to die, for any lingering doubt causes the power to fail instantly. A mortal slain this way may not be Embraced, cannot become a wraith, and is immune to any form of Necromancy upon her soul or body; medical or mystic examination reveals only sudden heart failure. Ending the Watch has no effect on any supernatural being: werewolves, changelings, wizards, ghosts, ghouls, mummies and the like are untouched. Valeren retests with Awareness.
